description: Generate a cohesive elevation / box-shadow ramp (layered ambient + direct light) with semantic level names (flat…modal), as CSS custom properties and Tailwind @theme, plus dark-mode guidance. Deterministic. Use one shadow token per level instead of hand-tuning shadows per component.

hue.description: Optional shadow tint as 'H S%' e.g. '220 40%' for a cool cast (default neutral black)

name: generate_elevation_system
title: Generate Elevation System
